name: koje-ui
description: koje's UI (ADR 0060): the GNOME Shell extension and the settings app; `just ui` builds, `just check-ui` checks.

scripts.build: node tools/daemon-types.mjs && tsc -p . && blueprint-compiler batch-compile build/settings/ui src/settings/ui src/settings/ui/*.blp && tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && node tools/build-extension.mjs
scripts.check: node tools/daemon-types.mjs --check && tsc -p . --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && vitest run
